jobs.title: Freelance E-Mail Marketing / CRM Manager | 100 % Remote (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du kennst dich mit Klaviyo aus, hast bereits E-Commerce-Marken betreut und möchtest weitere eigene Kunden und ein Team verantworten? Dann könnte das hier gut passen. Wir sind eine Agentur für E-Mail- und SMS-Marketing. Wir unterstützen DTC-Marken mit sieben- und achtstelligen Umsätzen dabei, mehr aus ihrem E-Mail-Marketing herauszuholen und langfristig zu wachsen. Bei uns übernimmst du die Betreuung mehrerer Kunden. Du entwickelst die Strategie, planst Kampagnen und koordinierst die Umsetzung mit deinem Team aus Copywriter, Designer und Klaviyo-Technician. Dabei behältst du die Ergebnisse im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden jederzeit wissen, woran wir arbeiten. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, klar kommuniziert und seine Aufgaben selbstständig voranbringt. Deine Aufgaben Kunden betreuen: Du bist der erste Ansprechpartner für deine Kunden, hältst sie auf dem Laufenden und kümmerst dich um Feedback und Freigaben. Strategien entwickeln: Du planst Kampagnen, Flows und Pop-ups, die zur jeweiligen Marke und ihren Zielen passen. Kampagnen planen: Du erstellst die monatlichen Kampagnenkalender und bringst eigene Ideen für Themen, Angebote und Tests ein. Dein Team koordinieren: Du briefst Copywriter, Designer und Klaviyo-Techniker und sorgst dafür, dass jeder weiß, was zu tun ist. Qualität prüfen: Du kontrollierst Texte, Designs und die technische Umsetzung. Du achtest darauf, dass jede E-Mail zur Marke passt und vor dem Versand sorgfältig geprüft wird. Deadlines einhalten: Du behältst den Überblick über laufende Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass alles pünktlich fertig wird. Korrekturen werden normalerweise innerhalb von 24 Stunden umgesetzt. Ergebnisse auswerten: Du analysierst die Performance, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und besprichst die Ergebnisse und nächsten Schritte mit deinen Kunden im monatlichen Reporting. Ordnung halten: Du sorgst für eine übersichtliche Struktur in Figma und Klaviyo, damit dein Team gut zusammenarbeiten kann. Das bringst du mit Er

Wir entwickeln Software, beraten, leiten Projekte und stellen Kunden erfahrene Spezialisten zur Seite: Entwickler, Business Analysten, Tester, Projektmanager. Dazu kommen Softwareprodukte, die wir selbst entwickeln oder als Partner vertreiben. Unser Vertrieb soll wachsen. Dafür suchen wir eine erfahrene Person, die IT-Dienstleistung von innen kennt und mit IT-Leitern über deren Projekte sprechen kann, bevor es um Preise geht. Ihre Aufgaben Sie gewinnen neue Kunden und bauen bestehende Accounts aus, vom ersten Termin bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag. Sie verkaufen beides: unsere Dienstleistungen (Softwareentwicklung, Consulting, Projektmanagement, Business Analyse, Testing) und verschiedene Softwareprodukte aus unserem Portfolio. Sie führen Bedarfsanalysen und Workshops mit IT-Leitern, Fachbereichen und Geschäftsführung. Sie verstehen, was beim Kunden technisch und kaufmännisch los ist, und schlagen eine passende Lösung vor. Sie erstellen Angebote gemeinsam mit unseren Delivery-Teams, kalkulieren Preise und verhandeln Verträge. Sie planen Ihre Accounts selbst: Pipeline, Forecast, nächste Schritte. Alles landet sauber im CRM. Sie halten Kontakt zu Herstellern und Partnern, deren Produkte wir mit anbieten. Unsere Anforderungen Mindestens fünf Jahre Vertrieb von IT-Dienstleistungen, Softwareprojekten oder IT-Lösungen im B2B. Sie wissen, wie ein Dienstleistungsprojekt läuft: Tagessätze, Festpreis, Rahmenvertrag, Staffing. Sie können mit einem Architekten über Technik und mit einem Einkauf über Konditionen sprechen. Erfahrung, Produkte und Dienstleistung in einem Angebot zu kombinieren. Nachweisbare Abschlüsse im Neukundengeschäft und ein Netzwerk sind ein Vorteil. jobs.title: Klaviyo Email Marketer for DTC Brands (deutsch)
jobs.description: Wir sind eine Full-Service-Agentur für E-Mail- und SMS-Marketing und unterstützen DTC-Marken mit sieben- und achtstelligen Umsätzen dabei, profitabel zu wachsen. Unser Schwerpunkt liegt auf leistungsstarken E-Mail-Flows, Kampagnen und Kundenbindungsstrategien mit Klaviyo. Als E-Mail-Marketing-Manager übernimmst du bei uns die vollständige Verantwortung für das E-Mail-Marketing mehrerer DTC-Marken. Du verantwortest Strategie, Umsetzung und Performance aller Kampagnen, Flows und Pop-ups. Du steuerst dein Team aus Designer, Copywriter und Klaviyo-Techniker und stellst sicher, dass alle Ergebnisse termingerecht, markenkonform und fehlerfrei geliefert werden. Deine Aufgabe ist es, die strategische Richtung vorzugeben, klare Qualitätsstandards zu setzen und sicherzustellen, dass jede E-Mail diesen Standards entspricht. Außerdem bist du der zentrale Ansprechpartner für deine Kunden und verantwortest die Kommunikation, die Performance und den Gesamterfolg der Zusammenarbeit. Dich erwartet ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Genauigkeit, schnelle Reaktionen und zuverlässige Leistung entscheidend sind. Du passt zu uns, wenn … ✓ du mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing für E-Commerce- oder DTC-Marken hast. ✓ du fließend Deutsch und Englisch sprichst und schreibst. ✓ du fundierte Kenntnisse im E-Mail- und SMS-Marketing für E-Commerce mitbringst. ✓ du bereits für eine Marke oder eine E-Mail-Marketing-Agentur gearbeitet hast. ✓ du Klaviyo sicher beherrschst und dich sowohl mit Flows als auch mit Kampagnen bestens auskennst. ✓ du ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Layout, visuelle Hierarchie, Abstände und modernes Design hast und verstehst, wie E-Mails gestaltet sein müssen, um nicht nur gut auszusehen, sondern auch Verkäufe zu erzielen. ✓ du schnell arbeiten kannst, ohne Abstriche bei der Qualität zu machen. ✓ du gut erreichbar und zuverlässig bist und klar mit deinem Team kommunizierst. ✓ du dein Team führen und dafür sorgen kannst, dass Aufgaben effizient vorankommen.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d) – Remote
jobs.description: Worum es geht MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen. Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen. Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig. Was du bei uns machst Als Lead AI Engineer führst du unser Engineering-Team, entwickelst rund drei Viertel deiner Zeit selbst mit und arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen. Deine Schwerpunkte: Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren. Technische Richtung. Du triffst wichtige Designentscheidungen mit, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem CTO die technische Roadmap und treibst die technische Vision von MAIA voran. Das Team anführen. Du koordinierst die Arbeit im Team und bist Sparringspartner für alle Engineers, in Designdiskussionen, Reviews und Feedback. Du führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wen wir einstellen. Besser werden, gemeinsam. Mit dem Team verbesserst du laufend, wie wir entwickeln, gerade im agentischen Arbeiten: von Plänen und Reviews über Evals bis zu Releases. Am Puls der Technik. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen bei LLMs, Retrieval, Agenten und darüber hinaus, bewertest sie nüchtern und bringst ins Produkt, was trägt. Was wir suchen Ein herausragender AI Engineer. Du hast LLM-Systeme gebaut und in Pro

jobs.description: About the role Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team. Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape. Who you are You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: About Seamflow Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files. Where we are: Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed , co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze. Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists. The team Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further. The role A Product Engineer owns the surfaces people actually work in. A coordinator planning a month of inspections across a fleet of auditors. A reviewer signing off on a technical file. These are dense, stateful workflows where the interface carries real consequences, and where the person using it has done the job for twenty years and will know immediately if the software doesn't understand it. You own product surface end to end: the interface, the backend that supports it, and the data model underneath. Every customer runs the work differently, so there's no template to fall back on. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.     Firmus AI Cloud Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI  compute  at scale to customers.   It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.     AI FactoryOS Operations   AI FactoryOS is Firmus proprietary operating system for the AI Factory. It governs GPU telemetry, cooling, power and grid interaction as one integrated layer, so that every Firmus site can be optimised and monitored as a single system.   AI FactoryOS Operations runs that platform in production and owns the 24/7 reliability of AI FactoryOS, Firmus AI Cloud and the platforms built on them, together with the service levels the estate is measured against.   The remit is an engineering one. A world where human judgement, empathy, systems thinking, and creativity become the real differentiators, while AI accelerates the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).  You will work closely with CXOs, product owners, engineers and data scientists to co-own the product vision and help them craft the path forward. Within the team, you will drive ambiguity towards real, valuable outcomes through design. You will own and shape the product direction, challenge weak assumptions and stay close to implementation. You will leverage your collective experience as a design practitioner in this entire journey for driving impact on the client side. Build the engineering spine of a mobile wallet used by more than two billion people across four continents. Ship the data product behind peer-review submissions for one of the world s largest scientific publishers. The list changes every quarter. The pattern doesn t: data-heavy, distributed, and often sitting on top of something that already exists and isn t perfect. jobs.title: Product Ops IA / Product Manager Ops - (H/F)
jobs.description: Mindset Chez Thiga, nous sommes convaincus que l’IA ne transforme pas seulement les produits, mais aussi la façon de les concevoir, de les construire et de les faire évoluer. Discovery, delivery, coordination, documentation, pilotage : tout le Product Development Lifecycle est en train d’être réinventé. La plupart des entreprises ont déjà démarré. Elles ont des POCs, des power users, des outils partout, parfois des gains individuels visibles. Mais elles peinent encore à transformer cette énergie en gain collectif , en nouveaux standards de travail et en performance durable . C’est là qu’intervient l’ AI Product Ops . Pas pour agir comme théoricien, mais pour repenser concrètement les modes de fonctionnement produit-tech, designer des équipes hybrides humains-agents, outiller les bons workflows, et faire de l’IA un levier d’efficience organisationnelle dans le delivery de produits digitaux. Chez Thiga, nous ne nous arrêtons pas à la recommandation. Nous construisons avec nos clients. Nous testons, nous outillons, nous faisons adopter. jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Du verantwortest Projekte, bringst eigene Ideen ein und treibst ihre Umsetzung voran. Dabei unterstützen dich Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die wollen, dass du erfolgreich bist. Was du bei uns bewegst Aus Daten Chancen machen: Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Marktdaten, etwa zur Auslastung von Fahrzeugen und Parkplätzen, und entwickelst daraus umsetzbare Empfe

jobs.title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
jobs.description: Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later. About the Role You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach. We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle. The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours. It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields. jobs.title: IT Specialist Backend Platform
jobs.description: Hou jij van complexe IT-omgevingen? Ben jij iemand die overzicht houdt, eigenaarschap neemt en graag werkt aan stabiele en veilige applicatieketens? Lees dan alles over de functie IT Specialist Backend Platform bij Univé en bouw mee aan een betrouwbaar, beheersbaar en toekomstbestendig Backend Platform. Wie ben jij Je bent een IT-specialist met een sterke operationele basis. Je krijgt energie van het stabiel, veilig en voorspelbaar laten functioneren van bedrijfskritische applicaties en platformdiensten en daarnaast weet je wat er in de markt speelt. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen techniek, operatie, leveranciers en stakeholders. Je weet hoofd- en bijzaken van elkaar te onderscheiden, behoudt overzicht in complexe applicatieketens en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een IT-richting. Ervaring als IT Specialist, Application Engineer, Platform Engineer of Applicatiebeheerder. Ervaring met beheer van backend-, kern- of bedrijfskritische applicaties. Je hebt affiniteit met AI-ondersteunde tooling en ziet mogelijkheden om deze verantwoord in te zetten voor analyse, documentatie, kennisdeling en procesverbetering. Werken binnen ITIL-processen. Daarnaast beschik je over: Sterk analytisch vermogen en het vermogen om complexe vraagstukken snel te doorgronden vanuit IT-perspectief. Een nieuwsgierige en onderzoekende houding ten aanzien van technologische vernieuwing en de inzet van AI. Flexibiliteit om te schakelen tussen beheer, projecten en verbeterinitiatieven. en proactieve houding en de drive om processen en dienstverlening continu te verbeteren. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een gestructureerde manier van werken. Wat ga je doen Binnen Backend Platform werken we aan het beheer, de continuïteit en de doorontwikkeling van het platform die direct bijdragen aan de betrouwbaarheid van de dienstverlening van Univé. Het team richt zich onder andere op: Beheer en continuïteit

jobs.description: About Doctolib Doctolib Connect is a secure medical communication app designed for healthcare professionals. More than 1M healthcare professionals use Doctolib Connect to discuss and coordinate patient care with colleagues both within and beyond their organizational walls. Today, Doctolib Connect is the largest medical network in Europe.  Since 2013, Doctolib has been striving for a healthier world by providing new-generation technology. With more than 2,800 employees across France, Italy, Germany and the Netherlands, Doctolib improves the daily lives of healthcare professionals and serves more than 80 million Europeans, offering a fast, frictionless, and secure journey for all their care needs. As a Fullstack Engineer , your mission will be to work on web features for our secure medical communication solutions that enable healthcare professionals to discuss and coordinate patient care with colleagues both within and beyond their organizational walls. You will be working in a feature team developing a product that powers Europe s largest medical network with over 1M healthcare professionals. Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams. Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Frontend (React): building and owning web features, reviewing code and setting quality standards Backend and APIs (Java): API-focused work that supports the frontend and the features it owns Technical leadership and delivery ownership: estimates, delivery plans, breaking down projects, giving the team context, accountability for results Collaboration and team practices: working with the PM and Designer, supporting ways of working and processes

jobs.title: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01
jobs.description: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01 Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten. Over de functie Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar): Werk je in dagdienst Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01 Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek. In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028): Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer
jobs.description: Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Medior–Senior, ~5 years of relevant experience About us AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet. The role As Embedded Engineer you own everything between the instrument hardware and our acquisition software. You integrate cameras, frame grabbers, motion controllers, piezo stages, lasers and FPGA timing hardware, and you make them run as one synchronized, reliable scan. The work is hands-on: vendor SDKs, trigger wiring, PCIe cards and lab networks one day, clean driver code and a live data stream to the user interface the next. You work closely with the System, Mechatronics, Application and Algorithm engineers. What you will do Design the trigger and acquisition architecture that synchronizes camera exposure, stage motion and laser pulses. Integrate industrial cameras and frame grabbers through industry-standard interfaces and vendor SDKs, from driver set-up to stable high-rate acquisition. Integrate motion controllers and positioning stages through vendor APIs and controller scripting, including commissioning and tuning with the Mechatronics Engineer. Develop and extend FPGA-based timing and I/O for triggering and position-synchronized acquisition. Write driver and control layers in C/C++ and Python that the scan and reconstruction software builds on, and expose live status and data streams to the user interface. Own the instrument PC and lab network set-up: PCIe hardware, high-speed Ethernet links between devices, IP planning and device discovery. Bring up and debug hardware in the lab with oscilloscope, logic analyzer and network captures, and document interfaces and timing budgets with the System Engineer. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. jobs.title: Meeloopstage Cash Control/ Finance
jobs.description: Wil jij ontdekken hoe de financiële motor achter een internationale logistiek dienstverlener draait? Ben je nauwkeurig, analytisch en krijg je energie van cijfers die kloppen? Dan is deze meeloopstage iets voor jou! Voor ons Cash Control team in Rotterdam zoeken we een stagiair(e) die meedraait in het dagelijkse cashmanagement. Je helpt bij het tijdig toewijzen van betalingen, het verwerken van bankafschriften en het bewaken van openstaande posten. Je werkt nauw samen met Credit Control, Invoicing en Accounts Payable en doet zo praktijkervaring op met cash application, reconciliaties en werken in ERP-systeem Exact. Waar ga je werken? Royal Den Hartogh Logistics is een internationale, toonaangevende logistiek dienstverlener voor de chemische, gas-, polymeer- en voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Ons familiebedrijf bestaat al sinds 1920 en heeft veiligheid en duurzaamheid stevig in het DNA verankerd. Met 54 locaties in 27 landen en ruim 2.600 collega's wereldwijd werken we continu aan slimme, toekomstbestendige logistieke oplossingen. Ons finance team in Nederland telt 20 collega's, verdeeld over onder andere Credit Control, Invoicing, Accounts Payable en Cash Control – en daar kom jij als stagiair(e) terecht. Wat ga je doen? Je bewaakt de dagelijkse Unallocated Cash : je houdt het overzicht bij, volgt openstaande posten op en rapporteert de belangrijkste KPI's. Je zoekt niet-herkende ontvangsten en niet-gematchte betalingen uit en helpt ze oplossen. Je boekt en verwerkt dagelijks bankafschriften in Exact, voor meerdere bankrekeningen en entiteiten (inkomend en uitgaand). Je matcht klantontvangsten en leveranciersbetalingen aan de juiste facturen. Je helpt bij bankreconciliaties en spoort verschillen op tussen bankafschriften en de administratie. Je denkt mee over verbeteringen om het toewijzen en afletteren efficiënter te maken. Dit wordt jouw baan Je vertaalt als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau ontwerpen in optimale en slimme bouwmethodieken. Met jouw technische inzicht, praktische aanpak en overtuigingskracht speel je een sleutelrol in onze tenders en in de voorbereiding van onze projecten. Je werkt op het bedrijfsbureau van Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed in Rotterdam en maakt onderdeel uit van een ervaren team, met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief. Jij bent vanaf het begin betrokken bij onze woningbouw- en utiliteitsprojecten. Jouw bijdrage is cruciaal voor het binnenhalen en goed voorbereiden van onze projecten. Je denkt actief mee over alternatieven en innovaties, met oog voor duurzaamheid en veranderende regelgeving. jobs.description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment. Where 50 Billion Daily Predictions Begin The User Experience team is the origin point of adjoe Ads. Everything the system knows about a user, every prediction the ML models make, every bid placed in an auction. It all starts with code this team ships. The team owns two responsibilities. On the SDK side, a native Kotlin and Swift code runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. It participates in 120 million daily auctions , renders ad creatives across multiple formats, and captures the behavioral signals that power 50 billion predictions per day . The constraint that defines this work: you're executing inside someone else's app, on someone else's device, with zero tolerance for instability. Every ad impression has to feel native and fast to the user. On the analytics side, the dashboards, investigation tools, and data frameworks that turn raw data into decisions: real-time revenue performance across active campaigns, infrastructure cost visibility, and data quality assessments. If a number matters to the business or to engineering, this team makes it accessible. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: Auction & Marketplace Analytics: You will monitor core ad exchange KPIs—including bid rates, win rates, timeout rates, eCPM, and render rates—and run deep dives to uncover bidding patterns and supply path optimization (SPO) opportunities. jobs.title: Senior Quantum Applications Architect
jobs.description: PsiQuantum s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.   Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.   Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.   That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum s most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel s Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico s Niklas

jobs.title: Solution Architect / Solution Engineer
jobs.description: Une nouvelle vision de la billetterie, au service du monde de la culture, des événements en direct, des loisirs et du sport. Bienvenue chez vivenu, leader mondial de la billetterie événementielle et l'une des entreprises technologiques à la croissance la plus rapide au monde. Nous avons révolutionné la billetterie de sites et producteurs comme les Grammy Awards, les Golden Globes, Fondation Louis Vuitton, Fondation du Patrimoine, Le Mans FC transformant les process de billetterie et les données collectées lors des parcours de vente en avantage stratégique. Bénéficiant d’investissements à hauteur de 65 millions de dollars, vivenu permet aux organisateurs d'événements de mettre en avant leur identité, de transformer l’expérience client, et d'intégrer la billetterie de manière transparente dans leur écosystème numérique. vivenu s’engage auprès de ses partenaires pour assurer un support d’excellence et pour répondre de façon simple à leurs enjeux en créant des expériences exceptionnelles. Rejoignez-nous et participez à la transformation des métiers de la billetterie et du marketing. En tant que Solution Architect, vos responsabilités comprendront: Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des intégrations sur mesure (connexions API, systèmes d’authentification SSO, ERP, etc.) en vous appuyant sur les puissants outils proposés par vivenu. Accompagner nos grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs boutiques en ligne existantes vers une architecture moderne, entièrement pilotée par nos API. Collaborer avec les différentes parties prenantes techniques de nos clients — directeurs techniques, équipes informatiques, agences web externes, etc. — afin de comprendre leurs besoins et de définir des plans d’action clairs et concrets. Veiller à ce que les attentes et les besoins des clients soient alignés avec les capacités de vivenu. Vous serez également le principal interlocuteur technique en interne pour traiter les problématiques complexes qui surviennent vente en période d’exploitation.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description: The Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist supports new customers through the Didomi onboarding cycle, from Kick-Off to deployment and handover to the Customer Success team. The role is the entry point into the Customer Onboarding career path and is performed under the guidance of the Onboarding unit manager. The Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist builds knowledge of the Didomi product suite and of customer privacy needs, keeps customer data up to date in Planhat, and relays customer feedback to the relevant internal teams. Key Activities : Manage a defined portfolio of new customers of lower complexity (Growth Business), with a volume adapted to the learning curve. Run the onboarding steps with support: Pre-Kick-Off, Kick-Off, setup and follow-up calls, Go-live monitoring, Platform Demo / QA, and closure Deliver standard product training sessions and share FAQs and Help Center content so that customers become autonomous Handle first-level implementation issues during the Onboarding phase and is an intermediate to the Support team. Flag onboarding risks (ghost customers, blocked projects) and apply the standard reminder and escalation rules Keep Planhat up to date in real time (owner, onboarding stage, date, tier, health, ghosting flag) Gather customer context from the Account Executive before Kick-Off and prepare the handover documentation for the CSM or KAM Collect customer feedback and log it for the Onboarding unit Contribute, with support, to a transverse initiative (documentation, training content, FAQs) Autonomy and Decision-making : Works under supervision and within defined onboarding playbooks and internal rules Follows the standard onboarding process and prioritizes daily actions with guidance Escalates technical complexity, blocked projects, and ghost-customer risks to the Onboarding unit manager,Product team or the Support team. Validates any workaround, exception, or on-hold decision with the Onboarding unit manager. Working Relationships : Internal:

jobs.title: Financial Risk Advisory - Director
jobs.description: Présentation du poste Dans le cadre du développement du bureau parisien de CFGI, le Directeur ou Senior Manager Risk Advisory SOX jouera un rôle clé en tant que leader de l’offre, accompagnant nos clients dans la complexité de la conformité SOX, pilotant des projets axés sur les contrôles internes, tout en développant l’équipe Risk Advisory SOX. Nos clients incluent un large éventail d’entreprises cotées ou en voie de l’être. jobs.description: 📍 Paris | Full-time | Fluent 🇫🇷 & 🇬🇧 At Bigblue, we're building the logistics backbone for the next generation of commerce. Modern brands sell everywhere: through their own online stores, marketplaces, retail, social commerce, and more. What used to be Amazon's exclusive advantage is now becoming the standard for every ambitious brand. We're helping them get there. jobs.description: E-commerce is booming — but independent brands still struggle to match the seamless logistics of giants like Amazon. At Bigblue , we’re on a mission to change that. We help brands turn fulfillment into a competitive advantage: scaling faster while delivering a five-star customer experience. Since 2018, we’ve built a tech-driven logistics platform powering 500+ brands — from fast-growing DTC players to global names like MUJI, Aigle, and Cabaïa . With 110+ employees across Paris, Madrid, and London , our proprietary WMS (Warehouse Management System) Atlas , and a network of 8 warehouses across Europe , we’re solving logistics challenges that others haven’t dared to tackle — making fulfillment faster, smarter, greener — and more cost-efficient. Backed by $20M+ in funding , we’re scaling rapidly — from 10 million orders in 2024 toward bold enterprise expansion. To deliver on this ambition, we are looking for a leader who will drive operational excellence and innovation at scale. The role: Professional Services Manager Merchants often need more guidance than our product alone can provide. They struggle with optimizing delivery options, managing customer support or demand planning and streamlining other operational processes. While our product addresses part of this need, merchants require structured, expert advice to grow and optimize their business. That’s why we’re launching a new Professional Services program — to help brands unlock the full potential of Bigblue Operations. As Head of Professional Services , you will build and lead this new function from the ground up: designing offers, structuring delivery, and ensuring execution at scale. Your mission is to sell (and sometimes offer) operational consulting , providing tailored support across logistics, transport, and commerce operations — while capturing and distributing the knowledge that will shape internal training, product development, and merchant strategy . tags: inl - institut des nanotechnologies de lyon
jobs.description: Présentation département L’Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon (INL) a pour vocation de développer des recherches technologiques multidisciplinaires dans le domaine des micro et nanotechnologies et de leurs applications. Les recherches menées s’étendent des matériaux aux systèmes. Le laboratoire s’appuie sur la plate-forme technologique lyonnaise Nanolyon. Les domaines d’application couvrent de grands secteurs économiques : l’industrie des semiconducteurs, les technologies de l’information, les technologies du vivant et de la santé, l’énergie et l’environnement. Le laboratoire est multi sites avec des localisations sur les campus d’Ecully et de Lyon-Tech La Doua. Il regroupe environ 240 personnes dont 120 personnels permanents. L’INL est un acteur majeur du Pôle de Recherche et d’Enseignement. Ce poste se situe dans un environnement innovant, à la pointe des technologies du futur, dans des secteurs stratégiques applicatifs. Le poste se situe dans un secteur relevant de la protection du potentiel scientifique et technique (PPST), et nécessite donc, conformément à la réglementation, que votre arrivée soit autorisée par l'autorité compétente du MESR Présentation de la ou les thématiques : Le programme PHOENIX est un projet national d’envergure (17 M€, 5 ans) financé par France 2030 et visant à structurer un hub français pour la conception de circuits intégrés, incluant les chiplets et les méthodes d’EDA enrichies par l’IA. Il implique plusieurs laboratoires du CNRS (INL, TIMA, IRISA, IETR, LIP6, LIRMM, LAMIH, IMS, Lab Hubert Curien, Lab-STICC…), le CEA-LIST, ainsi que de nombreux partenaires académiques et industriels. Dans ce cadre, nous recrutons un(e) ingénieur(e) informatique / EDA chargé(e) de la qualification des outils, modèles et blocs IP utilisés et développés au sein de PHOENIX, en interaction étroite avec les équipes de recherche, les doctorants et les partenaires industriels. jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-Doctoral Position Ferroelectric-Based Ternary Computing: From Circuit Design to System-Level Integration Scientific Context
tags: inl - institut des nanotechnologies de lyon
jobs.description: Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines. In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device. The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks: Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow. Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints. Develop and refine system-level models of FeFET-based ternary IMC units, abstracting circuit-level characterization results into architecture simulators, enabling design space exploration across the full heterogeneous system. Investigate hardware/software co-design strategies for mapping real-world applications — particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and signal processing kernels — onto the ternary IMC fabric, exploiting approximate computing techniques to trade precision for energy efficiency. jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
